L = 18
a = [0] * L
for i in range(1, L):
    a[i] = a[i - 1] * 10 + 1

def dfs(n, p):
    k = n // a[p]
    n = n % a[p]
    if n == 0:
        return p * k
    return p * k + min(p + dfs(a[p] - n, p - 1), dfs(n, p - 1))
